meta.name: arbor
meta.description: Autonomously improve a real artifact (code, training recipe, agent harness, data pipeline, prompt) against an objective and an evaluator, using Hypothesis Tree Refinement (HTR) from the Arbor paper. Use this whenever someone wants to iteratively optimize something over many experiments without overfitting — e.g. "get my model's eval score up", "improve this agent/harness", "tune this pipeline", "beat the baseline on this benchmark", "run a search over approaches and keep the best", "do an MLE-bench / Kaggle-style optimization", or any long-horizon "make this artifact better and don't just memorize the dev set" task. Trigger it even when the user doesn't say "Arbor" or "hypothesis tree" but describes repeated experiment-and-evaluate loops, branching exploration of competing ideas, or worries about a dev/test gap. Runs Claude itself as the coordinator with subagent executors in isolated git worktrees; for the standalone `arbor` CLI tool see references/arbor-upstream.md.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让代码、模型或流程自动跑大量实验,越改越好且不靠死记测试集
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果有个模型或脚本想靠不断试错调到更好,又怕只记住了测试集。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a model or script to tune through many trials and fear overfitting.

howto.what: Claude 会以你现有的代码、提示或训练配方为起点，按你给的目标和评分命令反复做实验，把假设与结论记在一棵持久假设树上，只有通过留出测试评分才把改动合并成新版本。
howto.when: 当你要反复做实验来优化某个具体产物（如模型评分、agent 表现、数据管道等），并且有明确目标和可运行的评分命令时触发，即使你没提到 Arbor。只想要一次性修改时不用它。

say.text: 用 Arbor 把这套 agent 的通过率优化上去
say.note: 它会先和你确认目标与 dev/test 评分命令

say.text: 给这个训练配方做多轮实验，出分最高的保留
say.note: 每轮在隔离 worktree 里跑，过测试门才合并

say.text: 跑完后给我报告：哪些假设通过、哪些被剪枝
say.note: 输出假设树状态和最终产物的分支

howto.what_en: Claude runs an autonomous optimization loop on your existing artifact: it proposes hypotheses, tests each in an isolated git worktree, and merges a change into the new best only when a held-out test evaluator confirms it.
howto.when_en: Use when you want repeated experiment-and-evaluate passes to improve a concrete artifact (code, agent, pipeline, prompt) you can modify and score. Not for one-shot fixes or ideation.

say_en.text: Use Arbor to raise this agent's pass rate
say_en.note: It first confirms the goal and dev/test eval commands

say_en.text: Run many experiment rounds on this training recipe and keep the best
say_en.note: Each runs in an isolated worktree; only test-gated wins merge

say_en.text: After the run, report which hypotheses passed and which were pruned
say_en.note: It prints the hypothesis tree and the final artifact branch
